   ```

   ```

   ```
   tmux kill-session -t exp_deberta_code_qwen1b5 2>/dev/null; echo "cleaned"
   ```


   ```
   grep -n "batch\|BS\|BATCH\|eval" /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination/scripts/run_deberta_code.py | head -20
   ```
